name: @elizaos/scenario-runner
description: Lean scenario runner for the WS7 scenario-schema architecture. Loads .scenario.ts files, executes them against a real @elizaos/core AgentRuntime with a live LLM, and emits a JSON report.

scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:mocks
scripts.test:deterministic:e2e: SCENARIO_USE_DETERMINISTIC_MODEL=1 bun --conditions eliza-source --tsconfig-override ../../tsconfig.json src/cli.ts run test/scenarios --lane pr-deterministic --report-dir ../../reports/scenarios/pr-deterministic --run-dir ../../reports/scenarios/pr-deterministic
scripts.test:corpus:pr:e2e: TZ=UTC SCENARIO_USE_DETERMINISTIC_MODEL=1 bun --conditions eliza-source --tsconfig-override ../../tsconfig.json src/cli.ts run ../test/scenarios --lane pr-deterministic --report-dir ../../reports/scenarios/pr-deterministic-corpus --run-dir ../../reports/scenarios/pr-deterministic-corpus
scripts.test:orchestrator:pr:e2e: EVAL_MODEL_PROVIDER=deterministic CEREBRAS_API_KEY= EVAL_CEREBRAS_API_KEY= ELIZA_E2E_CEREBRAS_API_KEY= SCENARIO_USE_DETERMINISTIC_MODEL=1 bun --conditions eliza-source --tsconfig-override ../../tsconfig.json src/cli.ts run ../../plugins/plugin-agent-orchestrator/test/scenarios --lane pr-deterministic --report-dir ../../reports/scenarios/pr-deterministic-orchestrator --run-dir ../../reports/scenarios/pr-deterministic-orchestrator --export-native ../../reports/scenarios/pr-deterministic-orchestrator/native.jsonl
scripts.test:lifeops:pr:e2e: TZ=UTC EVAL_MODEL_PROVIDER=deterministic CEREBRAS_API_KEY= EVAL_CEREBRAS_API_KEY= ELIZA_E2E_CEREBRAS_API_KEY= SCENARIO_USE_DETERMINISTIC_MODEL=1 bun --conditions eliza-source --tsconfig-override ../../tsconfig.json src/cli.ts run ../../plugins/plugin-personal-assistant/test/scenarios --lane pr-deterministic --report-dir ../../reports/scenarios/pr-deterministic-lifeops --run-dir ../../reports/scenarios/pr-deterministic-lifeops --export-native ../../reports/scenarios/pr-deterministic-lifeops/native.jsonl
scripts.test:pr:e2e: bun run test:deterministic:e2e && bun run test:corpus:pr:e2e && bun run test:orchestrator:pr:e2e && bun run test:lifeops:pr:e2e
